run: architecture candidate #11 (the tool transcript), drift D6: number provenance on a scripted known-answer run, read the old way beside the new on the same record (validation/__tests__/harness.test.js, src/__tests__/toolOutcomes.test.jsx); arms A and A+ on the dev set before (63c2d36) and after (4e18e8e), 2026-10-19
evidence: Number provenance (validation/harness.js, provenance.js) credits each checkable number of an answer to a value the model was shown, or calls it unsourced. It read every step's data and checks, a Workbench question's included, and nothing else of a step. A Workbench question sends the model no tool message: the model reads its note (joined to the question before the turn, or to the call it settled), never the card's question, answer or option meaning, which were credited anyway; and the note and the error, which the model did read, were not. Known answer on dev-offcentre: the Workbench asks about the window 1.6-1.93 A, which cuts the first Nb-O shell (1.58-2.48 A, CN 6; the card says the window holds 1.5 O per Nb), the simulated user skips, the call runs in the whole shell; a second call asks for a window to 16.5 A, past its maximum (the error names it). An answer repeating these numbers reads, the old way: 1.93 and 1.5 credited to the card's question, 1.58 and 2.48 to the card's option meaning, 16.5 unsourced (5 of 6 sourced); now: 1.93 and 1.5 unsourced (only the card held them), 1.58 and 2.48 credited to the Workbench's note, 16.5 to the error (4 of 6 sourced). 1.6, written with one decimal, is credited to the card's question the old way and to the note's 1.58 now, within the precision it was written with: provenance names the value it matched, for a reviewer. In the scripted turn of toolOutcomes.test.jsx the window the model asked for, 1.94 A, which only the card restated, moves from the card to unsourced. The 24 pinned scripted records' provenance is unchanged (no number in them was held only by a card, a note or an error). Arms A, A+ and D on the dev set before and after: all 45 records identical in verdict, score and readings (and identical to validation/baseline/arm-a-dev.json): their records carry no provenance, so nothing in them can move; they are not re-recorded. The test set was not run; its A and A+ numbers cannot move for the same reason, and a live B or C test run traces provenance under protocol 2026-10-19.13, not comparable with one under 2026-10-19.12 (none is committed). What the model is sent is unchanged; the protocol moves because what provenance means changed. Approved by the manager on the user's delegation, 2026-10-19.
proposed_fix: A number is credited only to what the model was told: each tool message it read (per step, the data as fitted, the checks, the error, then the note: the first that holds the number), the run context as the model read it and the question. A Workbench question contributes its note alone (the record keeps the text the model read of it as the step's note); its card's data and checks are kept in the record but are never a source. The transcript says what the model read of a Workbench question and labels the card's reply and checks as not sent to the model. PROTOCOL_VERSION 2026-10-19.13 (with the asked-before reading); docs/algorithms/copilot-validation.md describes the tracing. Approved by the manager on the user's delegation, 2026-10-19; the user may reverse it.
